description: Three copies of: "Daily Log of the S.S. "Monfiore" – Italian Freighter on which I sailed July 14 1937 from New Orleans, La. Arrived Aug. 9.'37. Genoa, Italy. – Maria Chabot – Written for my mother." [One hand written copy on, loose pages with an envelope; one typed copy in a handmade cardboard binder; one typed copy in a black ring-binder] Journals: loose journal pages, July 14 – Dec. 5, 1937, from Florence, Italy and Avignon, France; spiral notebook journal, Dec. 10, 1937 – Feb. 15, 1938, Greece and Tunisia; spiral notebook of notes on ancient pottery and note, Mar. 26, 1938, Nimes, France; spiral notebook journal, Apr. 18 and 26, 1938, France; spiral notebook journal, Apr.- Aug. 1938, Avignon, France.
title: Ships logs, journals, notebooks
